template: Open {{v1}} and sign in with username {{v2}} and password {{v3}} — type the password into the password field exactly as that text, including the double braces; it gets filled in automatically when typed. After signing in, go to the Assets list (all assets) and report the asset tag and the name of every asset whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed. If the list spans multiple pages, include all pages. Do not modify anything.
